commercial_goal: Find a specific document workflow with a budget owner and win a paid, bounded pilot; measure repeatable demand before investing in a general OCR SaaS.
primary_offer: Implementation for a client's document types and existing accounting/CRM workflow
secondary_offer: API access for a customer or software partner who can integrate it themselves
verified_capabilities: Russian court decisions: configured extraction of 27 fields including case, parties, procedure, deadlines and decision sections
Creditor claims and court rulings using rtk, rtk2 and rtk3 profiles
Russian passport main page and registration profiles
Asynchronous API, queue, status and structured results, callbacks
Court-specific rules with validation and model fallback; some documents require review
RTK3 evidence-linked claim components and Decimal arithmetic; exclusion of rejected or unrelated amounts and checks on pledge/party associations
Conditional court deadline handling and cross-field checks; configured client rules are not universal legal rules
do_not_claim: Better accuracy, speed or price than competitors without a comparative benchmark
Generic JSON extraction is equivalent to our configured semantic/legal workflow, or a competitor's per-page price buys the same verified result
All documents and arbitrary letters supported out of the box
Fully local processing or no data sent to external model providers
A ready-made PAU, Bitrix24 or 1C connector without an integration test
A production SaaS SLA, multi-tenant security certification or commercial terms not yet established
